scope: Metadata-only follow-up to three exact-unmapped KRAG taxon labels in the existing exposed 2700–3200 BP development window. No new cohort outcomes decoded or model executed.

taxa.provider_fact: The undifferentiated concept is placed under Poaceae (Cerealia), then Poaceae incertae sedis and Poaceae.
taxa.assessment: The retained definition does not specify rye exclusion, grain-size criteria, or equivalence to a calibrated cereal parameter group.

taxa.provider_fact: The morphological-type concept is placed directly under Poaceae incertae sedis. It is distinct from 427, and neither is the parent of the other.
taxa.assessment: A morphological type is not proof of an identified crop or rye-excluded cereal count. No source-compatible rye/parameter mapping follows.

taxa.provider_fact: The lineage is Schoenoplectus-type, Fuireneae, Cyperoideae, Cyperaceae; the leaf and Schoenoplectus-type are AQVP (Aquatic Vascular Plants).
taxa.assessment: This supplies a Cyperaceae family-parent candidate. It does not establish terrestrial-denominator eligibility, residual/disjoint accounting with existing family counts, or applicability of a Cyperaceae PPE/FSP calibration. UPHE at higher ranks does not replace the leaf aquatic classification.

manual_interpretation.types: Morphological types can include palynologically indistinguishable taxa; a type name alone is not a calibrated crop identification.
manual_interpretation.hierarchy: HigherTaxonID encodes taxonomic ancestry; uncertain types may be assigned above a species-level parent.
manual_interpretation.mutual_exclusivity: The pollen naming convention intends non-overlapping count categories. It does not independently demonstrate correct disjoint accounting in this particular KRAG import.
manual_interpretation.variables: A variable includes a taxon, units and potentially element, context or modification; taxon ancestry alone does not establish source-specific count or parameter compatibility.

remaining_evidence.cereals: Obtain the original identification/counting legend or a source-owned exact-variable crosswalk establishing cereal-type and rye membership, then justify compatibility with the selected parameter group. The API metadata does not equate either concept to pooled 2020 Cerealia or rye-excluded 2022 Cerealia-t.
remaining_evidence.sedge: Establish source-specific terrestrial/regional denominator eligibility and non-overlapping parent-count treatment, and justify the corresponding PPE/FSP profile before applying a parent rollup.

publication_scope: Only the ten exact public metadata responses, their acquisition identities, and this authored assessment are included. No private lookup routes, raw private rows or private workbooks are reproduced.
